name: medical-causation-ai
description: Enterprise SaaS platform for medical causation analysis

scripts.dev: npm run dev:infra && echo Run 'npm run dev:api' and 'npm run dev:web' in separate terminals
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d postgres redis pgadmin
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=api && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=api && npm run lint --workspace=web
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace=api && npm run format --workspace=web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=api && npm run typecheck --workspace=web
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.docker:infra: docker compose up -d postgres redis pgadmin
